forum.title: VD55G4 Promodule
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello Noeldi,

Welcome to ST Community and thank you for your interest in the VD55G4.

The VD55G4 is currently at preview stage, and we do not have a firm 55G4 promodule schedule at this time, I suggest you to do the design with I3C and VD55G1.

Thanks
forum.content_text: We will design a layout for the VD55G1 Promodule with Image read out over I3C. Alternative there is also a VD55G4 camera with an additional SPI image read out. Is it possible to get the pin assignment for the new VD55G4 promodule ?
